title: Loupe – A iOS app that raises awareness about what native apps can see
summary: Loupe is an iOS app that demonstrates and visualizes what native apps can access on a user's device, serving as an educational privacy awareness tool that shows real-time data collection by installed applications.
problem_solved: Helps users understand and visualize the extent of data that mobile apps collect from their devices in real-time.
why_valuable: Provides transparency into mobile app data collection practices, empowering users to make informed decisions about their privacy.
